original_target.title: Singular-set dimension of polyhedral partial-transport free boundaries

required_status_qualification: Solved on the basis of an unverified announcement. The full target is claimed in the cited source; the external proof has not been independently verified here.
scope_comparison: Theorem1.2 assumes bounded open source and bounded polyhedral target separated by a hyperplane, arbitrary0<m<min volumes, and gives a relatively closed exceptional set of dimension<=n-2 outside which the source free boundary is smooth. This includes every original n>=3 and nonconvex target. For finite-facet null slits, measure and closure are preserved under polyhedral fill; §6 uses the same canonical normalized obstacle pair and U={u>|x|^2/2-c_m}, so the active source and free boundary agree, rather than identifying arbitrary open representatives by measure alone. Proposition6.4 gives a local embedded graph.
